card.name: Dose units right after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word or unit piece (mg, mcg, units, IU, dL) directly after a dose number, usually just before "/kg", "per kg" or "per liter".

modes.label: Weight-based dose units
modes.description: A mass unit or its last letter after a number, followed by /kg.
modes.example: limit the total daily patient exposure to aluminum to no more than 5 mc<<g>>/kg/day.

modes.label: Units or IU after a number
modes.description: The word units or the piece IU after a number, followed by per kilogram or per liter.
modes.example: recommended starting dose of Insulin Glargine, U-300 in insulin-naive patients with type 2 diabetes is 0.2<< units>> per kilogram of body weight

modes.label: Unit pieces split inside the word
modes.description: A unit written in pieces, such as gram or dL, where the marked piece is partway through the unit.
modes.example: triglycerides greater than 250 mg<</d>>L in neonates and infants or greater

card.writes: It suppresses byte and unit-word tokens, so it seems to steer away from "bytes" or "units" as the next word after a measure.
card.plain: It marks the unit (mg, mcg, units) written right after a dose amount, especially in per-kilogram dosing.
